cohort: The study included pregnant females with singleton pregnancies, without a history of systemic disease, and with an indication for operative vaginal delivery.
finding: Transabdominal ultrasound was a more reliable modality (93.1% correct findings) compared to digital vaginal examination (75% correct findings) for identifying foetal malposition before instrumental vaginal delivery.
cross-section timing: August 2023-January 2024, performed during the second stage of labour
